23/// Filters and bounds for one managed-cache list operation.
24#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
25pub struct CacheListRequest {
26    /// Return aggregate diagnostics without per-cache entries.
27    pub summary: bool,
28    /// Keep entries in any of these states; an empty list keeps every state.
29    pub states: Vec<CacheState>,
30    /// Keep the exact recorded repository root, when present.
31    pub repository_root: Option<PathBuf>,
32    /// Maximum entries returned by one page.
33    pub limit: usize,
34    /// Opaque continuation cursor returned by the same filters.
35    pub cursor: Option<String>,
36    /// Keep entries in any of these content-compatibility classes.
37    pub compatibilities: Vec<CacheCompatibility>,
38    /// Keep entries with one of these exact versioned content identities.
39    pub index_content_versions: Vec<u32>,
40    /// Keep only safely classifiable older or unversioned content.
41    pub incompatible_with_current: bool,
42}
43
44impl Default for CacheListRequest {
45    fn default() -> Self {
46        Self {
47            summary: false,
48            states: Vec::new(),
49            repository_root: None,
50            limit: DEFAULT_CACHE_LIST_LIMIT,
51            cursor: None,
52            compatibilities: Vec::new(),
53            index_content_versions: Vec::new(),
54            incompatible_with_current: false,
55        }
56    }
57}

59/// Criteria and consent for one managed-cache prune operation.

61pub struct CachePruneRequest {
62    /// Remove caches not accessed for at least this many days.
63    pub older_than_days: Option<u64>,
64    /// Remove least-recently-used caches until managed bytes are at most this value.
65    pub max_total_bytes: Option<u64>,
66    /// Explicitly remove caches whose recorded repository root is missing.
67    pub remove_missing_roots: bool,
68    /// Report the resolved deletion plan without changing files.
69    pub dry_run: bool,
70    /// Confirm a non-dry-run deletion plan.
71    pub yes: bool,
72    /// Select inactive, recognizable older or unversioned caches.
73    pub incompatible_with_current: bool,
74}

76/// Metadata quality available for one cache directory.
77#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
78#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
79pub enum CacheState {
80    /// Current schema and access metadata were read successfully.
81    Current,
82    /// A readable older schema lacks current access metadata.
83    #[serde(rename = "legacy")]
84    OlderSchema,
85    /// Known cache artifacts exist without a readable database.
86    Incomplete,
87    /// The SQLite database could not be inspected.
88    Corrupt,
89    /// A newer schema or mismatched identity is not safe for this binary to prune.
90    Unsupported,
91    /// Unexpected content makes automatic deletion unsafe.
92    Unrecognized,
93}

95/// Compatibility of indexed content with the current LeanToken build.
96#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
97#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
98pub enum CacheCompatibility {
99    /// Content was produced for the current index-content version.
100    CompatibleCurrent,
101    /// Content was produced by a known older index-content version.
102    ObsoleteOlder,
103    /// The cache identity did not record an index-content version.
104    #[serde(rename = "legacy_unversioned")]
105    Unversioned,
106    /// Content was produced by a newer version this build must preserve.
107    NewerUnsupported,
108    /// Corrupt or unexpected metadata prevents a trustworthy classification.
109    Unknown,
110}

219/// Mutually exclusive result shapes for cache-list summary and page requests.
220#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
221pub(super) enum CacheListContents {
222    Summary,
223    Page {
224        next_cursor: Option<String>,
225        entries: Vec<CacheEntryReport>,
226    },
227}
228
229impl Serialize for CacheListContents {
230    fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> std::result::Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
231    where
232        S: serde::Serializer,
233    {
234        use serde::ser::SerializeMap;
235
236        let mut map = serializer.serialize_map(None)?;
237        match self {
238            Self::Summary => {
239                map.serialize_entry("returned_entries", &0usize)?;
240                map.serialize_entry("summary_only", &true)?;
241                map.serialize_entry("entries", &Vec::<CacheEntryReport>::new())?;
242            }
243            Self::Page {
244                next_cursor,
245                entries,
246            } => {
247                map.serialize_entry("returned_entries", &entries.len())?;
248                map.serialize_entry("summary_only", &false)?;
249                if let Some(cursor) = next_cursor {
250                    map.serialize_entry("next_cursor", cursor)?;
251                }
252                map.serialize_entry("entries", entries)?;
253            }
254        }
255        map.end()
256    }
257}
258
259impl CacheListReport {
260    /// Whether the request omitted per-cache entries.
261    pub const fn summary_only(&self) -> bool {
262        matches!(self.contents, CacheListContents::Summary)
263    }
264
265    /// Number of entries included in this response page.
266    pub fn returned_entries(&self) -> usize {
267        self.entries().len()
268    }
269
270    /// Cursor for the next stable identifier page.
271    pub fn next_cursor(&self) -> Option<&str> {
272        match &self.contents {
273            CacheListContents::Summary => None,
274            CacheListContents::Page { next_cursor, .. } => next_cursor.as_deref(),
275        }
276    }
277
278    /// Stable cache entries sorted by identifier and bounded to one page.
279    pub fn entries(&self) -> &[CacheEntryReport] {
280        match &self.contents {
281            CacheListContents::Summary => &[],
282            CacheListContents::Page { entries, .. } => entries,
283        }
284    }
285}

287/// Result action for one cache considered by prune.
288#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
289#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
290pub enum CachePruneAction {
291    /// No configured criterion selected this entry.
292    Kept,
293    /// Dry-run would delete this entry.
294    WouldDelete,
295    /// Managed artifacts were deleted.
296    Deleted,
297    /// A live process held the cache lease.
298    SkippedActive,
299    /// Unsupported metadata or unexpected content prevented automatic deletion.
300    SkippedUnsafe,
301    /// Filesystem deletion failed.
302    Failed,
303}

321/// Cache-prune decision with skip and failure details bound to valid actions.
322#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
323#[serde(tag = "action", rename_all = "snake_case")]
324pub enum CachePruneOutcome {
325    Kept,
326    WouldDelete,
327    Deleted,
328    SkippedActive { detail: String },
329    SkippedUnsafe { detail: String },
330    Failed { error: String },
331}
332
333impl CachePruneOutcome {
334    pub(super) fn skipped_active() -> Self {
335        Self::SkippedActive {
336            detail: "cache lease is held by a running process".into(),
337        }
338    }
339
340    pub(super) fn skipped_unsafe(detail: Option<String>) -> Self {
341        Self::SkippedUnsafe {
342            detail: detail.unwrap_or_else(|| "cache metadata is not safe to prune".into()),
343        }
344    }
345
346    pub(super) const fn action(&self) -> CachePruneAction {
347        match self {
348            Self::Kept => CachePruneAction::Kept,
349            Self::WouldDelete => CachePruneAction::WouldDelete,
350            Self::Deleted => CachePruneAction::Deleted,
351            Self::SkippedActive { .. } => CachePruneAction::SkippedActive,
352            Self::SkippedUnsafe { .. } => CachePruneAction::SkippedUnsafe,
353            Self::Failed { .. } => CachePruneAction::Failed,
354        }
355    }
356
357    pub(super) fn diagnostic(&self) -> Option<&str> {
358        match self {
359            Self::SkippedActive { detail } | Self::SkippedUnsafe { detail } => Some(detail),
360            Self::Failed { error } => Some(error),
361            Self::Kept | Self::WouldDelete | Self::Deleted => None,
362        }
363    }
364}

366/// Complete report for `cache prune`.
367#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]

383impl CachePruneReport {
384    /// Return true when one or more selected entries could not be deleted.
385    #[must_use]
386    pub fn has_failures(&self) -> bool {
387        self.results
388            .iter()
389            .any(|result| matches!(result.outcome, CachePruneOutcome::Failed { .. }))
390    }
391}

393impl CacheState {
394    pub(super) const ALL: [Self; 6] = [
395        Self::Current,
396        Self::OlderSchema,
397        Self::Incomplete,
398        Self::Corrupt,
399        Self::Unsupported,
400        Self::Unrecognized,
401    ];
402
403    pub(super) fn label(self) -> &'static str {
404        match self {
405            Self::Current => "current",
406            Self::OlderSchema => "legacy",
407            Self::Incomplete => "incomplete",
408            Self::Corrupt => "corrupt",
409            Self::Unsupported => "unsupported",
410            Self::Unrecognized => "unrecognized",
411        }
412    }
413}
414
415impl CacheCompatibility {
416    pub(super) const ALL: [Self; 5] = [
417        Self::CompatibleCurrent,
418        Self::ObsoleteOlder,
419        Self::Unversioned,
420        Self::NewerUnsupported,
421        Self::Unknown,
422    ];
423
424    pub(super) fn classify(entry: &CacheEntry) -> Self {
425        if matches!(entry.state, CacheState::Corrupt | CacheState::Unrecognized) {
426            return Self::Unknown;
427        }
428        match entry.index_content_version {
429            Some(version) if version == INDEX_CONTENT_VERSION => Self::CompatibleCurrent,
430            Some(version) if version < INDEX_CONTENT_VERSION => Self::ObsoleteOlder,
431            Some(_) => Self::NewerUnsupported,
432            None => Self::Unversioned,
433        }
434    }
435
436    pub(super) fn label(self) -> &'static str {
437        match self {
438            Self::CompatibleCurrent => "compatible_current",
439            Self::ObsoleteOlder => "obsolete_older",
440            Self::Unversioned => "legacy_unversioned",
441            Self::NewerUnsupported => "newer_unsupported",
442            Self::Unknown => "unknown",
443        }
444    }
445
446    pub(super) fn safely_incompatible(self) -> bool {
447        matches!(self, Self::ObsoleteOlder | Self::Unversioned)
448    }
449}
450
451impl CachePruneAction {
452    pub(super) fn label(self) -> &'static str {
453        match self {
454            Self::Kept => "kept",
455            Self::WouldDelete => "would_delete",
456            Self::Deleted => "deleted",
457            Self::SkippedActive => "skipped_active",
458            Self::SkippedUnsafe => "skipped_unsafe",
459            Self::Failed => "failed",
